caption: The drawing depicts a blue military-style coat shown from both the front and back perspectives, with the front view on the left and the back view on the right. The coat features a standing collar, long sleeves with wide cuffs, and a flared bottom. It has gold buttons running down the front, on the cuffs, and in a vertical arrangement at the rear split of the coat. The inside lining of the coat is a light tan color, which is visible in the front view. Below the coat illustrations, there is a circular detail showing a gold button with an ornate monogram design, and to the right of this, two rectangular swatches indicate the coat's color (blue) and the lining color (tan). The drawing includes the artist’s signature “BERNDT. DEL. 156-1” in the bottom right corner. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Men's Coat
